context_requirements: Bacterial cell wall synthesis machinery (e.g., penicillin-binding proteins, peptidoglycan precursors) is absent in human cells.
The annotated human targets are not known to mediate a transcriptional response to cell wall synthesis inhibitors in these cell lines.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines.
Enrichment of cell wall synthesis or bacterial response gene sets in the expression profiles.
Consistent changes in landmark genes across multiple cell lines that are not explained by vehicle or general toxicity.
